description: Concurrent meta/infra wave (US-535..US-548): finish package-seams-over-architecture-by-lint. Extract @lando/landofile and @lando/engine as private workspace packages, hoist business logic out of CLI command bodies, fix the app/services→cli layering inversion, extend check:package-dag to a full workspace DAG contract, and thin the behavioral scanner suite to justified residual bans. Public @lando/core stays the single publishable package (§2.7 rejection stands). No end-user surface changes.

§3.3 source layout describes the post-wave tree; §3.1 states shell must not own business logic and runtime must not import the shell.
§13.8 states the full workspace DAG contract (every edge declared; undeclared edges fail).

Tests pass; typecheck passes; lint passes

userStories.title: check:package-dag governs the full workspace DAG
userStories.description: As CI, check:package-dag validates every workspace package against one declared allowed-edge table instead of plugin-only rules plus an allowlist.
acceptanceCriteria: Rule loads workspace members from root package.json and fails on any workspace-member edge (dependencies or devDependencies) missing from the declared edge table.

Edge table distinguishes runtime from dev/test edges: plugin→plugin runtime edges (provider-podman→provider-lando) and existing plugin devDependencies on @lando/core (provider-lando, service-lando test harnesses) stay legal; runtime dependencies on core from plugins or seam packages stay forbidden.

Declared runtime contract: plugins→{sdk,paths,state-store,container-runtime,landofile,declared plugin peers}; engine→{sdk,paths,state-store,container-runtime,landofile}; landofile→{sdk,paths,state-store}; core→any; nothing runtime-depends on engine except core.
Focused tests cover undeclared edge, runtime plugins→core, and seam→core failures with tagged remediation.
check:import-cycle scans the new package roots.
Tests pass; typecheck passes; lint passes

acceptanceCriteria: Import-closure rule: anything a moved module statically imports either moves with it, is a seam package, or is inverted to an sdk-published tag/injected input; the engine package typechecks with zero @lando/core imports.

codegen:bootstrap-layers and codegen:bundled-plugins retargeted in the same change; codegen:check drift-clean at story close (a split would leave a state that cannot typecheck).
Core retains shell code only: cli, mcp, interaction, recipes, docs, testing, bin, generated composition root and bootstrap layers, §2.7 entry-point shims.
